Update 03

Signer’s First Rotation – What Happened on 17 November

Signer moved to new machines on 17 November 2026. The old key did not move with it. We made a new one.

10 chapters10 min read
Start with chapter 01 →

On 17 November Signer moved to a new set of machines while it was live on a real account.

The trading key did not move. The new machines made a new key together.

The old set was then removed from the chain, and the old signer machines were destroyed. This update explains how a rotation like that works, step by step, what went wrong on the day, and what we changed because of it.
